name: Shark
appearance: An ordinary shark with a streamlined body, narrow snout, prominent dorsal fin, and forked tail. The Fish entry gives no separate size or color for this row.

Combat.name: Feeding frenzy
Combat.effectNote: A shark can detect the scent of blood a mile away. The scent of blood and a kill can excite sharks into a feeding frenzy.

Combat.name: Bite and retreat
Combat.effectNote: Sharks close in, bite, and retreat. Up to ten normal-sized sharks can attack one man-sized opponent this way.

notes: The Salt Water summoning tables list sharks at 3–5, 5–6, and 7–8 HD.
Monstrous Manual, TSR 2140, January 1994 third printing, Fish pp. 117–118, with saltwater summoning on p. 378.

name: Giant Shark
appearance: A huge prehistoric-style shark, named megalodon in the entry. The portrait gives it a thick torso and broad jaws. The entry gives no measured length or color.

Combat.name: Swallow whole
Combat.effectNote: A Giant Shark can swallow most creatures whole when the attack roll is 4 above the minimum needed to hit. The entry says Giant Sharks never enter a feeding frenzy.

Shared Fish rules.name: Digestion and suffocation
Shared Fish rules.effectNote: A swallowed creature takes normal bite damage, then 1 point of digestion damage per round and a 5% cumulative chance of suffocating per round.

Shared Fish rules.name: Escape
Shared Fish rules.effectNote: A victim can cut free with a sharp-edged weapon. Others can cut or tear from the outside. The victim breaks free when the fish has lost 50% of its hit points.

notes: Monster Summoning VIII lists the Giant Shark in the Salt Water table.
Monstrous Manual, TSR 2140, January 1994 third printing, Fish pp. 117–118, with saltwater summoning on p. 378.
